app.title: Simple-Todo
app.tagline: Hand a list to someone standing next to you — no internet needed.

identity.heading: Who you are
identity.explain: You can use the app like this. But if you clear this browser, your lists are gone. A passkey keeps them and shows people who they got a list from.
identity.passkeyHidden: A passkey exists on this device. Lists you made with it stay hidden until you restore it.
identity.useOnDevice: Use the passkey on this device

list.heading: Your list
list.example: Or use the example list (10 jobs)
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {1 entry} other {# entries}}
list.onlyYouCanWrite: Only you can add to this list. Others can read it.

transfer.heading: Give this list to someone
transfer.holdUp: Hold this up so the other phone can scan it. Then tap “Scan their reply”.
transfer.showBack: Show this back to them so they can finish.
transfer.sent: Sent “{name}”. They decide whether to keep it.
transfer.linkSummary: Or send it as a link
transfer.staticCode: Static code — the other phone can scan it with its camera
transfer.staticCodeHint: One picture instead of a moving one, so a normal camera can read it and open the link. The connection is a little less reliable.

errors.notReady: The app is still starting. Please try again in a moment.
errors.noWritePermission: You cannot add to this list — it belongs to someone else.

todo.relayPending: Waiting for this entry to be copied by the relay.
todo.relayUnknown: No proof of relay replication is available for this entry yet.
todo.relayNotObserved: Relay replication was not observed for this existing entry.
todo.relayPinned: The relay confirmed that this exact entry was copied and stored.

tech.relayPeerMismatch: Relay peer ID does not match
tech.enterMultiaddr: Enter a multiaddress to connect to a peer.
tech.handshake: Opening the websocket and completing the libp2p handshake…
tech.sharePeerId: Share this ID with others to assign TODOs to you.
tech.copyAddressHint: Copy an address to connect another browser directly.
tech.didPlaceholder: did:key:… of the identity to allow
tech.openByAddress: Open a shared list by address

networkConfig.label: Network config
networkConfig.description: Validates the configured browser-reachable relay addresses and prepares the libp2p transports and services.

libp2p.label: libp2p
libp2p.description: Creates and starts the libp2p node, including its peer identity, discovery, relay, WebSocket and WebRTC support.

helia.label: Helia
helia.description: Starts the Helia IPFS node on top of libp2p and enables block exchange.

orbitdb.label: OrbitDB
orbitdb.description: Loads or creates the OrbitDB identity and initialises OrbitDB using the Helia node.

databaseSync.label: Database + sync
databaseSync.description: Opens the todo database, loads its local operation log and starts OrbitDB pubsub synchronisation.

localTodos.label: Local todos
localTodos.description: Connects the local todo store and starts filling it from OrbitDB in the background.

relayConnected.label: Relay connected
relayConnected.description: A live connection to a relay.

peerConnected.label: Peer connected
peerConnected.description: A live libp2p connection to another browser.

webrtcConnected.label: WebRTC connected
webrtcConnected.description: A direct WebRTC connection to another browser.
